````markdown
Search matched records on their free-text description as well as their name and tags, so any record that mentioned the term in passing showed up in the results. This change makes search match on name and tags only. Fixes SHOP-412.

## Changes

- `src/server/search.ts`: the where clause no longer includes the `description ILIKE` condition, so a record matches only on its name or tags.
- `src/server/search.test.ts`: a new spec checks that a record mentioning the term only in its description is not returned.

## Testing

- `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm lint` pass.
- All 14 specs in `src/server/search.test.ts` pass, including the new one.
- Ran `/search?q=economics` against a local copy of the staging database: it now returns 7 results instead of 9.
- `/desk-review` at `3f9c2ab`: `0 P0 · 0 P1 · 0 P2` across 2 files.

## Before / after

`/search?q=economics` on a local copy of staging:

| | Results |
|---|---|
| Before | 9 |
| After | 7 |

The two records no longer returned are tagged Business Studies and Psychology. Each one mentioned economics only in its description.
````
